title: Kinetic Text Reveal
description: Words rise out of masks one by one, then a blue highlight wipes in behind the key word. Great for hooks, titles and intros.

title: Stat Count-Up
description: A card pops in, the number counts up, a growth badge springs in and a sparkline draws itself. Works for any metric.

title: Bar Chart Growth
description: Bars spring up in a stagger, the final bar turns blue and a tooltip pops. Shows growth at a glance.

title: Automation Pipeline
description: Four steps activate in order while a progress line fills each connector and a check pops. Explains any workflow or process.

title: Prompt Typewriter
description: A prompt types itself into an input with a blinking cursor, then the reply card slides in with a staggered list.

title: macOS Folder Open
description: A cursor glides to a folder and clicks it, then a macOS-style window pops open and lists the files one by one.

title: Camera Pan & Zoom
description: A virtual camera zooms in on one card, pans across to the next, drops down to a third, then pulls back out to the wide shot.

title: Icon List Cascade
description: Rows slide in one by one, each icon spins into place, then a check pops on every row. For features, steps or any list.

title: Lower Third
description: A broadcast-style name tag wipes in over video, holds, then slides away. Perfect for interviews and talking-head videos.

title: Logo Reveal
description: The logo mark spins and springs in, then the wordmark unrolls beside it with a tagline fading up.

title: Word Roll
description: One word in a pill rolls up and out as the next rolls in. Great for taglines that speak to different audiences.

title: Phone Tap
description: A finger taps a button on a phone, the button presses and the screen swaps to a success state with a drawn check.

title: Notification Stack
description: Notifications drop in from the top one at a time and push the older ones down the stack.

title: Drag & Drop Upload
description: A cursor grabs a file, drags it onto a drop zone, then a progress bar fills and a check pops.

title: Settings Toggles
description: A cursor flips three switches one after another and each knob springs across with the track turning blue.

title: Command Palette
description: A search overlay opens, a query types itself and matching results cascade in with the first one selected.

title: Chat Conversation
description: Bubbles pop in, a typing indicator bounces, then the reply lands. Works for chats, support and bots.

title: Donut Chart
description: Three segments sweep around the ring in order while the total counts up and the legend slides in.

title: Leaderboard Race
description: Scores update and the rows re-sort with a smooth reorder while the bars resize. Shows who is winning.

title: Map Route
description: A route draws along the roads from a start dot to a destination pin that drops in, with an ETA chip.

title: Before / After Slider
description: A divider sweeps back and forth, revealing the colourful after over a faded before. Ideal for transformations.

title: 3D Card Flip
description: A card tilts, flips around in 3D to show its back, holds, then flips home.

title: Calendar Schedule
description: Events drop onto a weekly grid one by one with a bounce, then the last one is confirmed with a check.

title: Countdown Timer
description: Three, two, one, Go! Each number punches in while a ring drains, then the ring flashes green.

title: Success Burst
description: A check badge springs in, confetti bursts outward and falls, and the message fades up. Marks any win.

title: Caption Highlight
description: Word-by-word captions pop in over a speaker while a yellow highlight follows the spoken word. Shown in a vertical 9:16 frame.

title: Punch Zoom
description: Hard punch-ins on the speaker at each beat with a white flash on every cut and a zoom badge that ticks up.

title: Number Takeover
description: A black panel slides up over the speaker, a big number counts up, then the panel exits to reveal them again.

title: Color Block Title
description: A bold blue panel wipes across the speaker, the title words rise in, then it wipes away. Marks a new step or chapter.

title: Picture in Picture
description: The full-screen speaker shrinks into a rounded card while a title drops in above and chips pop in below.

title: Price Tag Swing
description: A tag swings in on its string like a pendulum while the price counts down to the deal. Great for offers.

title: Perspective Tunnel
description: Nested frames rush outward from the centre to fake depth while a speaker card floats inside.

title: Rack Focus
description: The speaker blurs out as a bold headline pulls into sharp focus, then focus swings back. A cinematic focus pull.

title: Follow Button
description: A cursor taps Follow on a profile card, the button flips to Following and hearts float up. A friendly call to action.

title: Strike & Replace
description: One word gets struck through and lifts away while the better word springs in with an underline.

title: Line Chart Draw
description: A smooth line draws through a dip and a recovery, the area fills in and a big percentage pops at the end.

title: Checklist Card
description: A card slides up over the speaker and each item gets ticked, struck through and greyed out. Shown in a vertical 9:16 frame.

title: Progress Ring Stat
description: A ring sweeps to 82% while the number counts up, then a trend badge pops in.

title: Time Saved Clock
description: The hands spin fast around an analog clock face, then a bold hours-saved badge pops in.

title: Skeleton Loading
description: Grey placeholder blocks shimmer, then the real content fades and slides in. Shows loading to loaded.

title: Pricing Cards
description: Three plans rise in one after another, then the middle plan lifts with a Popular badge.

title: Testimonial Quote
description: The quote reveals word by word, five stars fill in one at a time, then the author slides in.

title: Kanban Drag
description: A cursor lifts a card out of To do and drops it into Done while the Done counter ticks up.

title: Versus Split
description: Two panels slide in from opposite sides, meet in the middle and a VS badge pops between them.

title: Code Typing
description: A dark editor window types out lines of code with syntax colours, then a Run pill pops in.

title: Email Send
description: The Send button presses, the message folds away, a paper plane flies off and a sent pill pops in.

title: Audio Waveform
description: A podcast player where the waveform bars bounce and a blue progress fill sweeps across.

title: Integration Orbit
description: App icons pop in around a central hub, then slowly orbit it while staying upright. Shows everything connecting.

title: Text Scramble
description: Random characters flicker and lock in left to right until the headline is revealed.

title: Marquee Ticker
description: Three tilted rows of tag pills scroll endlessly in alternating directions. A lively background or social proof strip.
